decisions.important_context_note: ВОвсе and СОВСЕМ are not magical immutable spelling triggers in every context; the unit must test whether they actually strengthen negation. The source list is a route, not a bag of automatic magnets.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the identity and make semantic strengthening of negation the learner rule.

decisions.current_norm_note: The current academic rule explicitly distinguishes native structural cases and borrowed/lexical spellings. The school source may still practise them as one high-risk О-after-sibilants dictionary family, but the learner rationale must not pretend they all share one etymological exception mechanism.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one denominator practice family; store normative subgroup metadata and use item-level dictionary control in exercises.

decisions.current_norm_note: Current academic rules confirm a traditional lexical/root family and its derivatives. The denominator remains one family; surface derivatives are not separate knowledge identities.
decisions.patch_policy: Broaden normative scope to the current academic family without inventing new grade routes. Preserve the explicit exclusion of obsolete source material.

decisions.current_rule: The noun/root spellings with О and corresponding past-tense verb forms with Ё/Е belong to different morphological spelling patterns; part of speech/form is the decisive learner diagnostic.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the source pairs as grade anchors and use the broader current family only as normative scope.

cumulative_audit_progress.note: 136 is not yet declared final: two live HOLDs and one source-gated completeness candidate remain unresolved, and the one confirmed semantic absorption has not yet been consolidated into an active-manifest artifact.
